name: Tyrucrab
look: a little brown crab with an angry face and an orange back spike; its right claw is a Tyrunt's head, borrowed from Cobblemon's own Tyrunt
entry: To scare off predators it holds up its right claw, which has grown into the shape of a fearsome tyrannosaur's head. The jaw snaps like a pincer, and a Tyrucrab that fools a foe once never stops boasting about it.
how: Wild: uncommon on beaches, stony shores, mangrove swamps and in badlands.
